categories_default_key_length_check.name: categories_default_key_length_check
categories_default_key_length_check.value: "categories"."default_key" is null or char_length("categories"."default_key") between 1 and 60

categories_name_length_check.name: categories_name_length_check
categories_name_length_check.value: "categories"."name" is null or char_length("categories"."name") between 1 and 50

categories_key_or_name_check.name: categories_key_or_name_check
categories_key_or_name_check.value: "categories"."default_key" is not null or "categories"."name" is not null

card_automatic_debits_state_check.name: card_automatic_debits_state_check
card_automatic_debits_state_check.value: ("card_automatic_debits"."status" = 'recorded' and "card_automatic_debits"."movement_id" is not null and "card_automatic_debits"."reason" is null) or ("card_automatic_debits"."status" = 'skipped' and "card_automatic_debits"."movement_id" is null and "card_automatic_debits"."reason" is not null) or ("card_automatic_debits"."status" = 'pending' and "card_automatic_debits"."movement_id" is null and "card_automatic_debits"."reason" is null)

credit_cards_automatic_debit_idx.name: credit_cards_automatic_debit_idx
credit_cards_automatic_debit_idx.where: "credit_cards"."debit_ars_account_id" is not null or "credit_cards"."debit_usd_account_id" is not null

group_categories_name_length_check.name: group_categories_name_length_check
group_categories_name_length_check.value: "group_categories"."name" is null or char_length("group_categories"."name") between 1 and 50

group_categories_key_or_name_check.name: group_categories_key_or_name_check
group_categories_key_or_name_check.value: "group_categories"."default_key" is not null or "group_categories"."name" is not null

group_members_group_user_unique.name: group_members_group_user_unique
group_members_group_user_unique.where: "group_members"."user_id" is not null and "group_members"."left_at" is null

group_members_user_or_name_check.name: group_members_user_or_name_check
group_members_user_or_name_check.value: "group_members"."user_id" is not null or "group_members"."display_name" is not null

oauth_states_delete_account_binding_chec.name: oauth_states_delete_account_binding_check
oauth_states_delete_account_binding_chec.value: "oauth_states"."purpose" <> 'delete_account' or ("oauth_states"."user_id" is not null and "oauth_states"."session_family_id" is not null)

oauth_states_sign_in_unbound_check.name: oauth_states_sign_in_unbound_check
oauth_states_sign_in_unbound_check.value: "oauth_states"."purpose" <> 'sign_in' or ("oauth_states"."user_id" is null and "oauth_states"."session_family_id" is null)

users_display_name_check.name: users_display_name_check
users_display_name_check.value: "users"."display_name" is null or char_length("users"."display_name") between 1 and 50

holdings_price_all_or_none_check.name: holdings_price_all_or_none_check
holdings_price_all_or_none_check.value: ("holdings"."unit_price" is null and "holdings"."price_source" is null and "holdings"."priced_at" is null) or ("holdings"."unit_price" is not null and "holdings"."price_source" is not null and "holdings"."priced_at" is not null)

movements_shape_check.name: movements_shape_check
movements_shape_check.value: ("movements"."type" in ('expense', 'income') and "movements"."category_id" is not null and "movements"."rate" is not null and "movements"."rate_source" is not null and "movements"."rate_source" in ('automatic', 'manual') and "movements"."destination_account_id" is null and "movements"."destination_amount" is null) or ("movements"."type" = 'transfer' and "movements"."category_id" is null and "movements"."destination_account_id" is not null and "movements"."destination_amount" is not null and "movements"."destination_amount" = "movements"."amount" and "movements"."rate" is null and "movements"."rate_source" is null and "movements"."rate_type" is null) or ("movements"."type" = 'exchange' and "movements"."category_id" is null and "movements"."destination_account_id" is not null and "movements"."destination_amount" is not null and "movements"."rate" is not null and "movements"."rate_source" is not null and "movements"."rate_source" = 'implied' and "movements"."rate_type" is null)
